hooks.command: PHP_BIN="${LARABEACON_PHP:-php}"; if command -v "$PHP_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -f "$PHP_BIN" ]; then "$PHP_BIN" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.php" || true; elif [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/artisan" ]; then echo "The LaraBeacon plugin could not find PHP (${PHP_BIN}) on the PATH, so its MCP tools are unavailable in this session. If LaraBeacon comes up, tell the user to put PHP 8.2+ on the PATH or set LARABEACON_PHP to the PHP binary in the env block of the Claude Code settings, then restart Claude Code."; fi
